critical_pair: Immoozide is a potent inducer of HTX-5D.
Quorerol is cleared almost entirely by HTX-5D.

transcript.A|1:
Yes. Immoozide is described as a potent inducer of the enzyme HTX-5D, while Quorerol is cleared almost entirely by that same enzyme. Induction of HTX-5D by Immoozide would therefore increase Quorerol's metabolic clearance, reducing its plasma concentrations and potentially diminishing its therapeutic effect. Because Quorerol depends on HTX-5D for essentially all of its elimination, this is a mechanism-based interaction likely to be clinically significant, even though the exact magnitude (and Immoozide's own dependence on HTX-5D) is not stated in the provided information.

MECHANISM: Immoozide potently induces HTX-5D, increasing clearance of Quorerol (reduced Quorerol exposure)
FINAL ANSWER: YES
